name: 3C-AL
summary: 3C-AL, also known as 4-allyloxy-3,5-dimethoxyamphetamine or as α-methylallylescaline (3C-allylescaline), is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and 3C families related to 3,4,5-trimethoxyamphetamine (TMA). It is the amphetamine (3C) analogue of allylescaline.

pharmacology.text: The drug is a potent partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor and also interacts with other serotonin receptors and targets.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The pharmacology of 3C-AL was studied in greater detail in 2021.

summaryZh: 3C-AL是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C14H21NO3，屬於3,4,5-三甲氧基安非他命衍生物，結構與烯丙沙林類似，能作為迷幻藥物。
